Android 13+ blocks TTS engines from APK-installed apps. Enable it: Settings → Apps → Edge Read Aloud TTS → “Allow restricted settings” (or via adb: appops set --uid dev.experimental.edgetts android:allow_restricted_settings allow). Then select the engine in Settings → Text-to-speech.
Settings restored to their initial values.
Hello. This is a test of the Edge Read Aloud engine. The voice you hear is synthesized in the cloud.
The voice chosen here drives the whole system

This switch decides WHICH VOICE is used, not whether the system controls the engine. On: the whole system uses the voice chosen above for its language; if a book is in Spanish and your voice is another language, your last Spanish voice (a familiar one) is used. Off: the system picks the voice by each language country. The rate, pitch and example controls in Settings work either way, because they depend on the engine reporting its language, not on this switch.

The TTS engine will use the voice selected in THIS APP, not the one from the Android system, because this app offers more than one voice per language and region (the system offers only one). For it to work, choose "Edge Read Aloud TTS" as the preferred engine in Settings → Text-to-speech. For other languages, a catalog voice is used automatically.
